notes.title: An Important Announcement Regarding NOGIBATOR
notes.content: [p]We have an important update to share. We have made the decision to remove NOGIBATOR from sale on Steam, effective [b]July 22, 2025[/b].[/p][p]If you own NOGIBATOR, you will always own it. You'll still be able to download, install, and play it.[/p]
